propositions: The coverage-bearing ubuntu+py3.13 cell in the default-suite pytest step must emit coverage.xml via --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml without adding a new job or test run
A report-only diff-cover step must run only on the Gerrit Verified lane (when gerrit-refspec is set), comparing against HEAD^ and writing markdown output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with --fail-under=0
The diff-cover step must skip with a notice on the post-merge push/branch lane where no proposed diff exists
The gerrit-refspec must be routed through an env variable rather than direct template interpolation in the run block
The _COVERAGE_FLAGS constant and its three embeddings in test_ci_workflow_parity.py must be updated to include --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
No new CI matrix cells or job uses are added; only one extra cov-report flag on the existing coverage session plus one cell-gated report step
